name: silent-error-benchmark
description: Dataset collecting cases of "silent" errors where systems produce plausible-looking but incorrect outputs, intended to evaluate models' tendency to make undetected mistakes. It focuses on scenarios (likely code or reasoning) where outputs pass superficial checks but are functionally wrong, useful for robustness and evaluation of verification techniques. The benchmark is hosted on Hugging Face and appears to be a focused, small-scale resource.
evaluation_method: functional correctness / execution-based evaluation (e.g., pass@k / execution_accuracy)
reputation: Small, niche Hugging Face dataset with limited community adoption so far.
